sentences.text: Cannibalism is the act or practice of humans eating the flesh or internal organs of other human beings .
A person who practices cannibalism is called a cannibal .

The expression cannibalism has been extended into zoology to mean one individual of a species consuming all or part of another individual of the same species as food , including sexual cannibalism .	zoology	zoology	consuming all or part	cannibalism (zoology)	sexual cannibalism	sexual cannibalism

The Island Carib people of the Lesser Antilles , from whom the word cannibalism derives , acquired a long-standing reputation as cannibals following the recording of their legends in the 17th century .	Island Carib	Island Carib	Lesser Antilles	Lesser Antilles
Some controversy exists over the accuracy of these legends and the prevalence of actual cannibalism in the culture .

Cannibalism was widespread in the past among humans in many parts of the world , continuing into the 19th century in some isolated South Pacific cultures , and to the present day in parts of tropical Africa .	South Pacific	Australasia

Cannibalism was practiced in New Guinea and in parts of the Solomon Islands , and flesh markets existed in some parts of Melanesia .	New Guinea	New Guinea	Solomon Islands	Solomon Islands (archipelago)	Melanesia	Melanesia
Fiji was once known as the `` Cannibal Isles '' .	Fiji	Fiji

Cannibalism has been well documented around the world , from Fiji to the Amazon Basin to the Congo to Māori New Zealand .	Fiji	Fiji	Amazon Basin	Amazon Basin	Congo	Congo Basin	Māori	Māori people	New Zealand	New Zealand
Neanderthals are believed to have practiced cannibalism , and Neanderthals may have been eaten by anatomically modern humans .
Cannibalism has recently been both practiced and fiercely condemned in several wars , especially in Liberia and Congo .	Congo	Congo Basin
It is still practiced in Papua New Guinea as of 2012 for cultic reasons and in ritual and in war in various Melanesian tribes .	New Guinea	New Guinea	Melanesian tribes	Melanesians

Cannibalism has been said to test the bounds of cultural relativism as it challenges anthropologists `` to define what is or is not beyond the pale of acceptable human behavior . ''	cultural relativism	cultural relativism
Cannibalism has been occasionally practiced as a last resort by people suffering from famine , including in modern times .	famine	famine

Famous examples include the ill-fated Westward expedition of the Donner Party -LRB- 1846-7 -RRB- and , more recently , the crash of Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571 -LRB- 1972 -RRB- , after which some survivors ate the bodies of dead passengers .	Donner Party	Donner Party	Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571	Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571
Also , some mentally ill people obsess about eating others and actually do so , such as Jeffrey Dahmer and Albert Fish .	Jeffrey Dahmer	Jeffrey Dahmer	Albert Fish	Albert Fish
There is resistance to formally labeling cannibalism as a mental disorder .	mental disorder	mental disorder
